## Payroll Quarter

Set `year` and `quarter`; `fromDate`, `toDate`, `fromMonth` and `toMonth` follow. `journal` queries the Journal Month cards in those months.

From the standing `payroll` postings: `runCount`; `grossMinor` (the sum of their wage items); and `withholdingMinor`, `employerTaxMinor` and `netMinor` from the facts of the same names. The page shows the period and each total, with gross wages as the headline figure.

```ts
import { PayrollQuarter } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-registers';
```

### Non-goals
No operations and no filing; per-employee detail and a tie-out to the payroll liability accounts are not shown.

### Example
`PayrollQuarter/2026-Q1`, the first quarter of 2026.
attributes.cardDescription: A quarter's payroll totals: runs, gross wages, withholding, employer taxes and net pay, from the journal.
